title: Annotatio VI §.II: Triple difference — nude confictae, adiaphora, and real heads (German Einigkeit tract)
pass_a_gloss: So that for our Author this Class of controversies is rightly placed in a triple difference, of which some are nude fabrications — questions of fact, not of right — such as never entered any Reformer’s mind, e.g. Whether God is the Author of Sin? in the Chapter on God’s Providence; Whether omnipotent? in the Chapter on Corporeal Presence in the Supper; Whether merciful? in the doctrine of grace, etc. Others of lesser moment, on adiaphorous rites and ceremonies, in which Lutherans would easily have the Reformed obedient: Others finally more real, pertaining to the three said Principal Heads. Compare in the preceding Annotation the cited German tract of ours, Short Sketch of the Unity of the Evangelical-Lutheran and Reformed §.XIII and following.
pass_b_english: Our author therefore sorts this class into a threefold difference.

Some items are bare fabrications — questions of fact, not of right — that never entered any Reformer’s mind (Is God the author of sin? Is He omnipotent in bodily supper-presence? Is He merciful in the doctrine of grace?).
Others are lesser adiaphorous rites, where Lutherans would easily find the Reformed compliant.
Others again are more real and touch the three principal heads (see our German Short Sketch of Unity, §.XIII ff.).
source_text: Ut inde Autori nostro haec controversiarum Classis, in triplici differentia jure collocetur, quarum aliae nude confictae sint, quaestiones facti, non juris, quales Reformatorum nemini unquam in mentem venerunt, e. gr. Num Deus sit Autor Peccati? in Capite de Providentia Dei; Num omnipotens? in Capite de Praesentia Corporali in Coena; Num misericors? in doctrina de gratia, &c. Aliae minoris momenti, de ritibus & ceremoniis adiaphoris, in quibus facile Reformatos haberent obsequentes Lutherani: Aliae denique reales magis, ad tria dicta Capita Principalia pertinentes. Conf. in Annot. preced. cit. Tractatulum nost. Germanicum, Kurzer Entwurff der Einigkeit der Evangelisch-Lutherischen und Reformirten §.XIII. & seqq.
notes: Triple difference; nude confictae; adiaphora; reales; German tract §.XIII.
